items.title: Strengthening Democratic Oversight in National Security
items.description: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.description: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.description: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
items.description: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

items.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
items.description: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.

items.title: The Defender’s Window
items.description: AI is reshaping cybersecurity for attackers and defenders alike. Learn how OpenAI is strengthening its defenses and what security teams can do now.

items.title: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project
items.description: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project, expanding community investment and supporting thousands of Southern Ohio jobs

items.title: New policy ideas for the Intelligence Age
items.description: OpenAI funds 14 independent projects exploring new AI policy ideas to expand economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience in the Intelligence Age.

items.title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
items.description: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.

items.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
items.description: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.

items.title: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
items.description: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization and help businesses realize the full value of AI.

items.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
items.description: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.

items.title: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
items.description: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.

items.title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
items.description: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.

items.title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
items.description: OpenAI and AWS are making Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock to support enterprise security workflows.
